items.title: Kalshi sues Louisiana attorney general to block state gambling enforcement against its sports event contracts, SportsBettingDime reports
items.content_text: - **Kalshi sues Louisiana attorney general to block state gambling enforcement against its sports event contracts, SportsBettingDime reports** — Kalshi filed suit against Louisiana and Attorney General Liz Murrill seeking a temporary restraining order and preliminary and permanent injunctions, arguing the Commodity Exchange Act gives the CFTC exclusive jurisdiction over its event contracts. The complaint cites a state law that took effect August 1 expanding the definition of gambling by computer, a December 2025 Gaming Control Board advisory declaring such contracts illegal gambling, and public comments by Murrill describing the contracts as gambling. ([SportsBettingDime](https://www.sportsbettingdime.com/news/industry/kalshi-sues-louisiana-attorney-general-to-prohibit-state-gambling-laws/))

items.content_text: - **NBA names Kalshi and Polymarket preferred prediction market exchanges and signs CFTC integrity pact, CDC Gaming reports** — The NBA on Monday designated Kalshi and Polymarket as its preferred prediction market exchanges and signed a memorandum of understanding with the CFTC. The agreements limit permissible NBA markets, bar league and team personnel from trading NBA contracts, require information sharing on suspicious trading, and give both exchanges NBA intellectual property rights and official data from Sportradar to settle authorized markets. ([CDC Gaming](https://cdcgaming.com/nba-takes-sides-in-prediction-market-fight-with-kalshi-and-polymarket-deals/))
